result:
I added the Account activity card and the Download my data button to the profile page. Nothing has been run: no tests, lint, typecheck or app. Two generation steps still need running before CI will pass (see the end).

**Account activity card**
- It shows when the account was created and when you last logged in. Both values are already on the user record the page loads, so this part needed no new backend.
- Dates use the shared formatting helper and the user's locale. They are shown in UTC with the zone label, because the card is rendered on the server and there is no per-user time zone to use instead.
- If no login has been recorded, it says "No login recorded yet".

**Download my data**
- The repo rules say not to add new server actions, so the data comes from a new endpoint, `GET /api/v3/me/data-export`, called from the page with TanStack Query.
- The endpoint only works with a logged-in session; API keys are rejected. It takes no user id, so you can only ever export your own data.
- It reads everything in one database query.
- The JSON file contains name, email, locale, notification settings and each organization membership (organization name and role). I also added an `exportedAt` timestamp (UTC), which the file name uses: `formbricks-account-data-YYYY-MM-DD.json`.
- The data is only fetched when the button is clicked, and it is not kept in memory afterwards. If the download fails, an error message pops up.
- Memberships include any not-yet-accepted ones, because the export reads all membership records for the user.

**Other changes**
- I documented the new endpoint in the API spec under `docs/api-v3-reference/src/`. Like the existing tag endpoints, it is hidden from the published docs.
- I updated the operation counts in `docs/api-v3-reference/contract-tests/README.md` (63 → 64 documented, 55 → 56 tested).
- The new text strings are only in `en-US.json`.
- I added a small unit test for the endpoint's auth and response, at `app/api/v3/me/data-export/lib/operations.test.ts`. It has not been run.

**You still need to run**
1. `pnpm api:v3:bundle` regenerates the committed `docs/api-v3-reference/openapi.yml`. My attempt to run it needed approval and did not run. Until it runs, the `pnpm api:v3:check` step in lint will fail because the bundle is out of date.
2. `pnpm i18n` generates the translations for the other locales from `en-US.json`. I did not run it because it calls the Lingo.dev service.

- `modules/account/lib/account-data-export.ts`
